## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3 (sprint verifier-fail slice): touchpoint review-artifact test passes asserting cycles[] for sprint verifier-fail
- dd-6 (sprint verifier-fail slice): single ticket comment per cycle references artifact path — sprint verifier-fail

## Testing Mode
RED (bundled: create test + edit SKILL.md — Gate 2)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (Edit — verifier-fail re-dispatch block)
- tests/scripts/test-sprint-verifier-fail-cycles.sh (Create)

## Implementation Notes
Edit sprint/SKILL.md verifier-fail re-dispatch block (added by story f63c-1ca6-b210-4fa5) to call append_review_cycle.py after each cycle + emit one ticket comment referencing artifact path. Add single-comment-policy prose.

Shell pattern:
python3 plugins/dso/scripts/append_review_cycle.py --artifact <path> --n <n> --draft-hash <hash> --findings-count <count> --verdict <verdict>
.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <ticket-id> "Remediation cycle <n> recorded at <artifact-path>"

## Cross-story dependency
This task requires the sprint verifier-fail re-dispatch block from story f63c-1ca6-b210-4fa5 to exist before adding cycles[] calls.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. tests/scripts/test-sprint-verifier-fail-cycles.sh exists and is executable
2. grep -q 'append_review_cycle.py' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md → found
3. grep -q 'ticket comment' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md → found  
4. grep -qi 'not duplicat\|references the artifact path' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md → found
5. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-sprint-verifier-fail-cycles.sh → PASS
data.title: Wire cycles[] append + single-comment policy into sprint verifier-fail re-dispatch block
